title: HtmlHtml
responsibility: Renders the native html element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlHtml.attributes
inputs.description: Native html attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlHtml.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native html element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlHtml
outputs.description: The actual native html element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
